health.report.title: 🩺 PC health report (read-only, nothing is modified or deleted)
health.report.footer: All results above are read-only; this tool will not change any setting for you.
health.report.markdown.title: # PC health report
health.report.markdown.footer: > This report is a read-only health check; no system content was modified or deleted.
health.common.fast_skipped.advice: Drop the fast flag to run this check
health.slow_skipped.label: Slow health checks
health.slow_skipped.detail: Time budget exceeded; skipped to keep the health check fast
health.os_version.label: OS version
health.os_version.detail.registry_failed: Failed to read the registry; cannot determine the OS version
health.os_version.advice.old_windows: Windows 10 no longer receives feature updates; consider upgrading to Windows 11
health.os_version.detail.failed: Failed to read the OS version
health.windows_update.label: Windows Update paused
health.windows_update.detail.ok: Updates are not paused; security updates are received normally
health.windows_update.detail.missing_exp: A pause record exists but there is no expiry time; cannot tell whether it is still in effect
health.windows_update.advice.resume: Resume updates in Settings → Windows Update → Pause updates
health.windows_update.detail.expired: The last pause expired at {expiry}; updates have resumed
health.windows_update.advice.long_pause: A long pause misses security patches; resume updates in Settings → Windows Update
health.windows_update.detail.failed: Failed to read the update pause state
health.pending_reboot.label: Pending reboot
health.pending_reboot.detail.ok: No pending system changes that need a reboot
health.pending_reboot.advice.reboot: Reboot soon so updates and installs actually take effect
health.pending_reboot.detail.failed: Failed to read the pending reboot state
health.secure_boot.label: Secure Boot
health.secure_boot.detail.missing: Secure Boot state not found (legacy BIOS/MBR boot, or the feature is not enabled)
health.secure_boot.advice.enable: Enable Secure Boot in BIOS/UEFI (requires GPT + UEFI boot)
health.secure_boot.advice.bios: You can enable Secure Boot in the BIOS to block boot-level malware
health.secure_boot.detail.failed: Failed to read the Secure Boot state
health.tpm.label: TPM security chip
health.tpm.detail.no_service: No TPM service detected (TPM may be disabled in firmware or unsupported by the device)
health.tpm.advice.enable: If the motherboard supports it, enable PTT/fTPM in the BIOS
health.tpm.detail.no_chip: The TPM service exists but the firmware reports no TPM chip
health.tpm.advice.firmware: Enable PTT/fTPM in the BIOS (required by BitLocker and newer Windows)
health.tpm.detail.failed: Failed to read the TPM state
health.disk_space.label: Free disk space
health.disk_space.detail.critical: ; {drives} below 5% free, the system may become unstable
health.disk_space.advice.clean: Clean the disk now (this tool's cleanup can help) or uninstall large files
health.disk_space.advice.low: Clean the disk or move large files off the system drive (below 5% free causes slowdowns)
health.devices.label: Problem devices in Device Manager
health.devices.detail.no_output: pnputil returned no output; cannot determine device status
health.devices.advice.manager: Open Device Manager, find devices with a yellow mark and update their drivers
health.devices.advice.reinstall: Open Device Manager to update or reinstall the matching drivers
health.unexpected_shutdown.label: Unexpected shutdown records
health.unexpected_shutdown.detail.no_log: Unable to read the system event log
health.unexpected_shutdown.detail.ok: No unexpected shutdowns in the last 7 days
health.unexpected_shutdown.detail.count: {count} unexpected shutdown records in the last 7 days
health.unexpected_shutdown.advice.check: If this happens often, check the power supply, memory stability and drivers (blue screens)
health.unexpected_shutdown.detail.failed: Failed to read unexpected shutdown records
health.smb1.label: SMB1 protocol
health.smb1.detail.no_config: No SMB1 service configuration found (SMB1 is off by default)
health.smb1.advice.disable: Disable SMB1 (uninstall SMB 1.0/CIFS under optional features); it has known security holes
health.smb1.detail.failed: Failed to read the SMB1 configuration
health.insecure_guest.label: Insecure guest logon
health.insecure_guest.detail.not_set: Insecure guest logon is not enabled (registry value absent, which means off)
health.insecure_guest.advice.disable: Turning it off prevents man-in-the-middle attacks; use credentialed shares instead
health.insecure_guest.detail.failed: Failed to read the guest logon configuration
health.firewall.label: Windows Firewall
health.firewall.detail.unreadable: Unable to read the firewall configuration
health.firewall.advice.enable_all: Turn on every profile in Windows Security → Firewall & network protection
health.firewall.detail.failed: Failed to read the firewall configuration
health.antivirus.label: Antivirus software
health.antivirus.detail.no_security_cent: Unable to read Security Center information
health.antivirus.detail.none_registered: No antivirus product is registered with Security Center
health.antivirus.advice.install: Install and enable an antivirus product (built-in Defender or a third party)
health.antivirus.detail.unparsable: Security Center data could not be parsed
health.antivirus.advice.enable_realtime: Make sure real-time antivirus protection is turned on
health.antivirus.detail.failed: Failed to read the antivirus state
health.phantom_devices.label: Phantom device leftovers
health.phantom_devices.detail.unable: Unable to count devices (both PowerShell and pnputil failed)
health.phantom_devices.detail.count: {count} non-present device records detected (leftovers from previously attached devices; normal, not a fault)
health.phantom_devices.advice.ignore: No action needed; only clean up if Device Manager shows a problem
health.disk_health.label: Disk health (temperature/wear)
health.disk_health.detail.no_storage_mod: Unable to read physical disk information (storage module unavailable)
health.disk_health.detail.unparsable: Physical disk information could not be parsed
health.disk_health.advice.hot: Disk temperature is high ({disks}); improve case cooling or check the airflow
health.long_paths.label: Long path support
health.long_paths.detail.not_set: Long path support is off (registry value absent)
health.long_paths.advice.enable: Enabling it stops deep-directory dev tools from failing on long paths (Group Policy or registry LongPathsEnabled=1)
health.long_paths.advice.enable_short: Enabling it stops deep-directory dev tools from failing on long paths
health.long_paths.detail.failed: Failed to read the long path configuration
health.hibernation.label: Hibernation file
health.hibernation.advice.off: If you do not need hibernation, run powercfg /h off to free this space (turns off fast startup)
health.hibernation.detail.absent: {path} does not exist; hibernation is off (no system drive space used)
health.hibernation.detail.failed: Failed to check the hibernation file
